I would recommend Workbay for your events if you’re hosting meetups, flea markets, etc.

The elevator leading to the workspace on the third floor is big which makes it easy to carry equipment or merchandise.

2 large tables, 1 medium sized table and 1 long table. The latter has a long bench on both sides.

Separate washroom for men & women.

Fridge: in case you need to cool beverages, recommend confirming with the coworking space.

I recommend getting an appointment to visit the space & discuss details; this will help their team to ensure your event goes smoothly.

featured_reviews.name: Bansri Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
FOR ART LOVERS / ART ENTHUSIASTS / EXPLORERS

Dot Line Space is a warm place for ArtLovers - as it encourages the first time artexplorers to not only leave their inhibitions but also explore visual arts and  experience it .
Dot line Space headed by Curator Gourmoni Das brings beautiful and unique art shows to Mumbai , they curate for Nine Fish Art Gallery, apart from Exhibitions they have  a Ceramic Studio  - White and Gray  which is amazing to explore,  and also the PrintAdda
- the print making equipped  studio, I have personally loved exploring my creative block with ceramics and it worked for me!
Dot Line Space also conducts a varied workshops with experts guiding art explorers to develope and know their creative process.

FOR ARTSITS / INTERNS
Dot Line Space is an encouraging platform for upcoming artists to show their work and also for established artists to strengthen their portfolios.
An apt curatorial team works to put a show together where an artist feels seen and heared, there are open calls, group shows , curated solo shows , mentorship programmes, studio visits which is open to all, residency,  scholarship and more ,  for interns wanting to learn and gain experience there is possibility of volunteering and paid internships.

FOR ART BUYERS :
Dot Line Space makes enough room for first time buyers , I remember I could buy my first work cause I felt a deep connect and also I could afford to find a range that fits my spending capacity , there are exclusive sales too with complete guided art  buying experience. From the team to the curator himself the whole foundation makes this possible !

Wishing everyone happy exploration with Dot Line Space !

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Lal Tr
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Dot Line Space Art Foundation is connecting art and cultural spaces within the metropolitan city of Mumbai. In today’s contemporary art scene, very few organizations are as closely connected to the broader community, fostering a cultural environment through art. The Dot Line Space Art Foundation, in collaboration with Nine Fish Art Gallery, has built a remarkable bridge between rural and urban art and culture. Bringing together diverse artists under one roof with equal recognition is truly commendable. The atmosphere feels like a family, creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all.

The recent establishment of the Print Adda studio for printmaking practices, catering to both eminent and emerging artists, is another significant achievement. Mr. Gourmoni Das, the founder and director of the foundation, is the cornerstone of this initiative, and his efforts are deeply appreciated. A big congratulations to Mr. Anurag Kanoria—your kindness and support have been instrumental in making the Dot Line Space Art Foundation’s vision a reality.

featured_reviews.name: Mushtaque Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Company had booked the space for 1 month, but we had to move out within 1 week as we had an extremely disappointing experience at this co-working space. The infrastructure is in terrible condition — the building itself is dilapidated and unsafe as it has been flagged by the municipal authorities. During the monsoon, the situation becomes unbearable with constant leakages from ceilings and AC units inside office and flooding outside the office

The washroom facilities are frankly unacceptable. There are no basic amenities like tissues, the jet sprays don’t work, and cleanliness is severely lacking. Despite repeated complaints, there seems to be no responsible staff or management willing to take ownership or resolve issues.

Parking is another major headache, and the approach road is in poor condition, making daily access frustrating. The premises are also overcrowded with e-commerce delivery traffic, which adds to the chaos.

The cafeteria area is no better — it frequently experiences water flooding, and there is a persistent sewage stench that makes it unpleasant to even sit there. On top of that, pest control is clearly neglected, adding to the unhygienic environment.

Overall, this space falls far below even basic standards for a professional work environment. I would strongly advise others to reconsider before choosing this location.
